notes: Second step of the consolidation. With a custom cohort now monitorable, screen-promotable, and editable, a watchlist symbol-list has no capability a cohort lacks — so the lists move to Cohorts and the tab stops being about lists. The Watchlists tab is now Alerts. It holds the two things that actually belonged there: price and event alerts, and the market calendar — reframed as a dated-events view of the same tab rather than a separate feature.
